plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talking with a video maker named Chris Ramsay, praises a piece Ramsay made on the Lacerta files. Michels describes them as documents from Sweden about reptilians, meaning lizard-like beings said to live among or beneath humans. He mentions them as one of the stranger corners of the subject that Ramsay has explored.
